tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Cattail Rust, sampled from the emblem. The primary button fill: the one thing to press per screen. Links on Bone (16px+). Rust rules under H2. Bone label on it 4.82:1, white 5.15:1.

tokens.name: brand-primary-bright
tokens.usage: Copper, derived for contrast. Dark grounds only: links, eyebrows, step numerals, icons, the phone button's ring, focus rings. Holds Soil Black text only (5.74:1); never Bone or white on it (3.39:1). Not text on Bone under 24px (3.17:1).

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Earth Brown, sampled. Primary button hover fill, dividers, stitched-patch borders, body text and eyebrows on Bone (7.45:1). Never text on Soil (2.44:1).

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Clay, sampled. Icons, borders and subtle highlights on dark (10.33:1 on Soil Black). Never text, line or icon on Bone (1.76:1).

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Soil Black, sampled. The page ground (dark-first), header, footer; the emblem's home ground.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Soil Surface. Cards on a Soil Black section; alternating dark sections; photo slots.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Soil Elevated. Inputs on dark, raised cards, the sticky mobile call bar, badges, neutral notices.

tokens.name: bg-light
tokens.usage: Bone, sampled from the letter face. Light reading sections: the process, the FAQ, the estimate form. Never place the transparent emblem on it.

tokens.name: bg-light-alt
tokens.usage: Bone Alt. Alternate light section; print paper tint. Links here are Soil Black with a Rust underline (Rust text is 4.01:1).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Bone text on bg-base, bg-surface and bg-elevated (18.17 / 16.73 / 15.11:1). Display, headings and body on dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Dust, sampled. Secondary text and captions on bg-base, bg-surface, bg-elevated (8.59 / 7.91 / 7.15:1).

tokens.name: text-on-light
tokens.usage: Soil Black text on bg-light and bg-light-alt (18.17 / 15.11:1). Headings and body on Bone.

tokens.name: text-muted-on-light
tokens.usage: Dust Dark, derived. Secondary text and form hints on bg-light (7.28:1) and bg-light-alt (6.06:1); every form field border on Bone.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Clay at 16%. 1px card edges and dividers on Soil grounds.

tokens.name: border-subtle-light
tokens.usage: Soil at 10%. 1px dividers and table rules on Bone; never the only edge of a form field.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success state on dark only (5.84:1 on bg-base). Not a brand color. Fails as text on Bone (3.11:1): there use text-on-light with a success icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on dark only; the CONFIRM BEFORE PUBLISHING badge (9.01:1 on bg-base). Fails as text on Bone (2.02:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error borders (2px) and icons. Error text on bg-base and bg-surface only (4.90 / 4.51:1); not under 24px on bg-elevated (4.08:1); never text on Bone (3.71:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero line only. Graduate 400, uppercase. clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.25rem): 32px mobile to 52px desktop.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, one per page. Graduate 400, uppercase. clamp(1.75rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem): 28px to 40px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heads, with a rust rule under. Graduate 400, uppercase. clamp(1.375rem, 3vw, 1.875rem): 22px to 30px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above an H2. Graduate uppercase. brand-primary-bright on dark; brand-secondary on Bone.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, FAQ questions. Source Sans 3 700, title case.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: First we clear it. Then we cut in the driveway. Then we build the pad.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Price comes down to five things: acreage, how thick the trees are, stumps, how far the fill hauls, and how high the pad needs to be.
styles.usage: Paragraphs. 60 to 75 characters a line, left aligned.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above the field, text-on-light on Bone.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Independence · 3 ac cleared · 300 ft drive · pad
styles.usage: Captions and form hints. text-muted on dark. Nothing on the website goes below 14px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field; tight internal spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items; mobile side margin; the gap between the two CTA buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between groups; card padding; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile and tablet.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The hero and the closing call-to-action band only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, text badges. Angular: never a pill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards (or an 8 to 12px 45-degree chamfer instead).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media and photo slots; modals if one is ever needed.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; 32px side margins on desktop.
